name: openDialog-closeDialog
description: openDialog and closeDialog emit no effect and leave page and app state unchanged: the executor hands openDialog's dialogId and heightFactor (0.4 here; 0.5 when absent) to the host's sheet (Flutter's onOpenDialog, awaited until the sheet closes), and closeDialog asks the host to close the top sheet, never a page. With no host wired, as here, both do nothing. Native parity step 8.
